description: Use this when the user has explicitly confirmed a specific draft letter (recipient, content and total price) and wants it printed and posted. Pays the letter from the user's prepaid credit and releases it to print; it can be cancelled with cancel_letter only until production starts. Only call this after that confirmation and after the user agreed to the Terms (https://printandmailcompany.com/en/legal/terms) and to printing starting immediately (which ends the consumer right of withdrawal once printed). If credit is too low, the result contains a payment link for the user; the assistant cannot pay. A US Letter PDF to a recipient outside the US, Canada and US territories needs paper_size (ask the user: shrink to A4, recommended, or keep US Letter; same price); without it the call fails with PAPER_CHOICE_REQUIRED and nothing is charged. Posts paper letters only: no email, fax or parcels. Needs the user's account.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly confirmed sending this letter (recipient, content and total price).

letter_id.description: letter_id of the draft the user confirmed, from create_letter or compose_letter, e.g. ltr_8f3k2m9q4x7v1c6b0n5p. Sending charges its total to the user's prepaid credit.

paper_size.description: The user's choice for a US Letter PDF to a recipient outside the US, Canada and US territories: "a4" = shrink to A4 (recommended), "us_letter" = keep US Letter. Same price. Saved on the draft before paying; ignored for other letters. No default: omit unless the user has chosen.

user_accepted_terms.description: Must be true: the user agreed to the Terms and to the immediate start of printing.

name: send_letter
title: Send letter (charges credit)
